# NavGujarat Academy

> NavGujarat Academy is a next-generation Learning Management System (LMS) designed for modern online education, interactive quizzes, live classrooms, code playground, and AI tutor assistance.

## Overview
NavGujarat Academy provides comprehensive educational tools for students, instructors, and administrators:
- **Course Catalog**: Expert-led video & article courses covering Web Development, Cloud Computing, AI & Machine Learning, Data Science, and Design.
- **Interactive Code Playground**: Multi-language browser-based code execution sandbox for Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, C++, and Java.
- **AI Tutor Assistant**: Gemini-powered conversational AI study partner capable of explaining concepts, debugging code, generating flashcards, and summarizing lectures.
- **Live Interactive Classes**: WebRTC and real-time live streaming classrooms with live chat and attendance tracking.
- **Assessments & Quizzes**: Timed quizzes, grading rubrics, assignment submissions, and instant feedback.
- **Verified Certificates**: Cryptographically verifiable course completion credentials.

## Key Public URLs
- [Home Page](https://navgujaratacademy.online/): Portal overview, featured courses, testimonials, and statistics.
- [Course Catalog](https://navgujaratacademy.online/courses): Searchable and filterable catalogue of all public courses.
- [Code Playground](https://navgujaratacademy.online/playground): In-browser interactive code editor and runtime.
- [Help Center](https://navgujaratacademy.online/help): Student guides, FAQ, and technical support.
- [Platform Status](https://navgujaratacademy.online/status): Real-time system health and uptime.
- [Privacy Policy](https://navgujaratacademy.online/privacy): User privacy and data protection terms.
- [Terms of Service](https://navgujaratacademy.online/terms): Platform usage and content licensing policies.
